details: The Bitcoin-linked Liquid Network, a blockchain utilized by various cryptocurrency exchanges for faster transactions, has been compromised, resulting in the theft of approximately 4,000 Bitcoin, valued at about $320 million. The network has since halted all new transactions as federation members actively work to resolve the incident and restore normal network activity. The perpetrators have been described as "purported white-hat hackers" who often exploit vulnerabilities with the intention of returning funds, sometimes for a fee.
title: Bitcoin-Linked Liquid Network Hacked for $320 Million

details: Several altcoins, including Dash, experienced significant gains of over 70% last week, outperforming Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana. Bitcoin itself quickly recovered above the $80,000 mark after a brief dip, despite renewed expectations for a September interest rate hike following strong US nonfarm payrolls data. US spot Bitcoin ETFs continue to attract substantial investment, with cumulative net inflows reaching approximately $3.8 billion over the past three weeks, signaling robust spot demand.
title: Altcoins Rally and Bitcoin Recovers to $80K Amid ETF Inflows

details: Analysts at Bernstein project a bullish long-term outlook for Bitcoin, forecasting its price could reach $300,000 by the end of 2029 in their base case scenario, with a potential surge to $500,000 under optimal bull conditions. This optimistic prediction is underpinned by expectations of continued currency debasement, the advent of greater regulatory clarity, and a growing trend of institutional adoption within the cryptocurrency space.
title: Bernstein Predicts Bitcoin to Reach $300K-$500K by 2029
